content.text: Make sure comp / field is used correctly in the diagnostics and operations for the changes in this PR. Particularly in the case of evaluate. Instead of being "physical field" in the descriptions please change "Physical" (and maybe add something about this in a skill file). Agents (and humans) like to refer to some things as physical (e.g. a vector component, Cartesian coords), but their counterparts are often physical too (e.g. a DG component, curvilinear coordinates); they just simply have another representation. So it's generally best to avoid this word.

I’ll review the PR’s use of `comp` and `field`, especially in `evaluate`, and replace misleading uses of “physical.” I’ll also add the terminology guidance to the relevant skill. I’m using the design, data, API/CLI, and development skills for this review.

text(await tools.apply_patch("*** Begin Patch
*** Update File: /home/maxwell-rosen/postgkyl/.agents/skills/data/SKILL.md
@@
 # Preserve data meaning
 
+## Terminology and selection
+
+Avoid "physical" as a distinction between representations: DG coefficients
+and point values, or Cartesian and curvilinear coordinates, can all describe
+the same physical quantity. Name the actual representation or coordinate
+system instead.
+
+`select(comp=...)` indexes the stored last axis; on packed DG data it extracts
+raw coefficients or nodes and drops the DG basis. `select(field=...)` selects
+whole fields, preserving their complete DG blocks. Diagnostics that operate
+on fields must use `field`; `comp` is appropriate for stored-array components.
+On unpacked point values these selectors coincide. `evaluate` tokens such as
+`f0[1]` and `f0[0:3]` use field selection, preserving DG arithmetic semantics.
+
+## Storage and representation
+
 Storage (`backend`: `gkyl` or `numpy`) and representation
*** End Patch"));
